name: B10-0536/2026 (Renew) – Le protocole d’accord illégal entre la Turquie et la Libye et la violation de la convention des Nations unies sur le droit de la mer
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the illegal Türkiye-Libya Memorandum of Understanding and infringement of the United Nations Convention on the Law of the Sea
part_text:
The European Parliament is not changing any law here. It is stating its position: it says the 2019 maritime deal between Türkiye and Libya is legally void and should be scrapped. It asks Türkiye and Libya to respect the United Nations Convention on the Law of the Sea, urges the European Union to renew sanctions against Türkiye and stand by Greece and Cyprus, and calls for stronger protection of sea routes and undersea cables.

- **What changes:** Nothing yet. Parliament only calls for action; no law or measure is adopted.
- **Who it affects:** Türkiye, Libya, Greece, Cyprus, and European Union shipping and energy projects.
- **What happens next:** The European Union's governments must decide whether to renew sanctions before 30 November 2026.
